limitations: Morphine clearance and respiratory effects are not modeled. Severe hepatic impairment lacks adequate pharmacokinetic studies in the cited label.
user_message: Morphine exposure with recorded hepatic impairment merits medication review; this sandbox cannot calculate clearance or respiratory effects.
